description_html:
Key Features

  • Dunite-Shell Construction: Engineered with a durable dunite-shell, this calender roller offers enhanced longevity and resistance to wear, ideal for demanding industrial processing environments.
  • Generous Working Width: Features a working width of 180 centimeters, accommodating large material batches and increasing production efficiency for textile, paper, or polymer processing.
  • Precise Process Temperature: Operates at a stable process temperature of 14°C, supporting consistent results and minimizing thermal distortion for sensitive materials.
  • Batch Throughput: Capable of processing up to 33.6 kilograms per batch, enabling high-volume manufacturing and reducing downtime between cycles.
  • Extended Cycle Hours: Designed for long operational cycles, with a 70-hour cycle time to support extended production runs and minimize interruptions.
  • Manual Drive Operation: Fully manual drive system allows for straightforward setup, ease of use, and precise operator control without the need for complex automation.

Main Benefits

  • Durability and Reliability: The robust dunite-shell ensures the roller withstands heavy use and harsh processing conditions, reducing maintenance needs and replacement costs.
  • Increased Productivity: Wide working width and high batch throughput help manufacturers maximize output and meet large-scale production targets efficiently.
  • Consistent Performance: Precise temperature control and long cycle hours deliver uniform results, which is crucial for quality-sensitive applications.
  • User-Friendly Operation: Manual drive system provides direct, hands-on control, suitable for operators seeking simplicity and reliability without the complexity of automated drives.
  • Cost-Effective Processing: Extended cycle times and high throughput contribute to lower operational costs and improved value over time.

Typical Use Cases and Outcomes

  • Industrial Manufacturing: Well-suited for textile finishing, paper calendaring, and polymer sheet production where consistent pressure and temperature are critical.
  • Batch Processing: Ideal for facilities requiring high-volume, continuous processing with minimal downtime between cycles.
  • Custom Production Lines: Manual operation allows for flexible integration into existing production lines where operator oversight and adaptability are prioritized.
  • Quality Assurance: Enables manufacturers to achieve uniform surface finishes and thicknesses, addressing common user needs for product consistency and reliability.

Frequently Asked Questions

  • Is this roller compatible with automated lines? This model features a fully manual drive, making it best suited for manual or semi-automated production environments.
  • How durable is the dunite-shell construction? Dunite-shell rollers are recognized for their exceptional resistance to abrasion and high-temperature stability, ensuring a long service life.
  • What is the typical delivery or pricing process? Unit price is determined after acceptance, allowing for tailored quotations based on specific operational requirements.
